gloss: mitigation measure; easing measure; relief measure

definitions.gloss: mitigation measure; easing measure; relief measure
definitions.explanation: a policy, action, or plan designed to reduce the severity of a problem, ease restrictions, or relieve pressure on a situation

examples.japanese: ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧{緩和策|かんわさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: To consider measures to ease traffic congestion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な{緩和策|かんわさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}した→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧。
examples.english: The government put forward new easing measures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{緩和策|かんわさく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{補助金|ほじょきん}→補助金：19222_hojokin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An expansion of subsidies was proposed as a mitigation measure against soaring prices.

notes:
Combines ⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧ (easing, relaxation, mitigation) and ⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧ (measure, policy, plan). A formal term from news and policy discourse, used for government and organizational responses to problems. Covers a wide range of contexts: economic policy, environmental measures, traffic solutions, and public health responses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧{緩和策|かんわさく}: monetary easing measures
- {規制|きせい}{緩和策|かんわさく}: deregulation measures
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{緩和策|かんわさく}: pain relief measures
- {緩和策|かんわさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じる→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧: to implement mitigation measures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: countermeasure — a broader term for any measure taken against a problem
- {救済策|きゅうさいさく}: relief measure; rescue plan — emphasizes helping those already affected
- ⟦{解決策|かいけつさく}→解決策：19395_kaiketsusaku⟧: solution — aims to fully resolve the issue, not just ease it
